metadata.source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Data Profiles & Morris County 2026 Certified Rolls

zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Pompton Plains & Boulevard Corridor, Sunset Road & Farm Road District
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 2.58%, with an equalization ratio of 81.4%.
Public education represents 63.8% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 26.4%.
Average residential assessment is $476,190, producing an average annual tax bill of $12,285.7.

neighborhoods.name: Pompton Plains & Boulevard Corridor
neighborhoods.character: Classic Morris County suburban community with wide tree-lined boulevards, colonial residences, cape cods, and community parks
neighborhoods.description: Quiet family township in the Pompton River valley, featuring excellent township municipal services and Chilton Medical Center.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Equalization ratio of 83.2% with balanced school and municipal levy proportions.

neighborhoods.name: Sunset Road & Farm Road District
neighborhoods.character: Quiet residential streets with cape cods, ranches, and colonials near Pequannock High School campus
neighborhoods.description: Established suburban neighborhood with sidewalks and direct access to high school sports fields.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Stable municipal finance with consistent 98%+ tax collection rates.

equityAnalysis.summary: Pequannock Township maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Pequannock Township, homeowners pay an average of $12,285.7 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 9.36% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 81.4%, assessed values average ~81.4% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 63.8% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 26.4%, and Morris County claims 9.8%.
